newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt cotton sales resume momentum.
newsitem.headline: Egypt cotton sales resume momentum.

text.p: Egypt exported 204 tonnes of cotton in the 18th week of the season, a slight increase in pace after a Christmas and New Year lull, the Alexandria Cotton Exporters Association (Alcotexa) said on Sunday.
The association has approved a further 306 tonnes for export to Turkey -- a deal put off from the 13th week, it said.
The accumulative total for cotton export commitments this season rises to 62,073 tonnes, it added.
The organisation coordinates prices and exports by private and state-owned firms.
Egypt has said it expects to export between 125,000 and 150,000 tonnes of last year's harvest.
